issue_context.title: Music permanent muted if song previewed in direct and imported while sitting in song select
issue_context.body:
**Describe the bug:** 
Go into song select and let the music play. Open Direct and preview a song. while its previewing, the current song gets muted. Download the song while its previewing and let it import. Result is that the music is perma muted until the game is restarted.

**Screenshots or videos showing encountered issue:** 
https://streamable.com/cd5bc

**osu!lazer version:** 
2019.1113.0

**Logs:** 
[runtime.log](https://github.com/ppy/osu/files/3840571/runtime.log)

review_comments: how is this testing that mute was undone? and why is the "allowupdate" required?

well, this test is ensuring that the current track changes correctly as we're assuming `Stop` will remove the audio bindable, `AllowUpdate` is required to check if the `CurrentTrack` didn't change before the scheduled stopped event is invoked.
why not test for it? that's generally what we do.

In general `current == null` is the less important half of the desired behaviour we want here. With regression tests you generally want to test the actually important user-facing part of the regression, which is the volume (from what I can see it should be easily exposed). `current` being `null` could well be considered an implementation detail.
